title: Choose the explainer's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Operating Manual. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Operating Manual
options.lineage: Braun / Dieter Rams instruction leaflets, DIN technical documentation
options.thesis: Every explainer is a page from the manual for the thing you pointed at.
materials: line diagrams with numbered callout keys
Buddy blue marks what you pointed at
options.viewport: Section number and title in DIN caps; the one-sentence answer set large across a solid Buddy-blue band; Figure 1 below, a line diagram whose numbered keys ①②③ match the steps beside it.
options.risk: Can feel cold or corporate if the diagrams are timid; it lives or dies on the model drawing real figures.

raised.raise: Nothing sits in a box: no cards, no tiles, no bordered callouts. Hierarchy comes from grid position and type size alone.
Buddy blue is committed at field scale (the answer band holds about a quarter of the first view), not sprinkled as accents.
Figures encode quantity: bars, flows and parts are drawn to true proportion, never decorative.
The answer is set as the page's dominant typographic mass, large enough to read across the room.

options.label: The Field-Guide Plate
options.lineage: Peterson and Sibley field guides, natural-history identification plates
options.thesis: What you pointed at becomes a specimen: drawn, labeled with leader lines, and classified.
options.viewport: Plate number and common name up top; the subject drawn large with leader lines to its labeled parts; a 'similar species' strip comparing it to things it is confused with.
options.risk: Strong for concrete things you point at, strained for abstract ideas that have no specimen to draw.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Letters condense into words and break into weather.
options.viewport: A single word-weather event per view.
options.case: Fuses poorly: transforming type fights comprehension of an unfamiliar idea.
options.kept: The headline as the page's dominant mass.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One pull turns a flat plane into a shaped volume.
options.viewport: A flat semicircle gathering into form.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to explaining software or ideas.
options.kept: One governing geometry rules every alignment.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Rank is depth on an emissive black void; nothing is ever boxed.
options.viewport: One still line of text over drifting dust.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a novelty register for a reference artifact meant to be kept.
options.kept: No enclosure: hierarchy without boxes or rules.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Steps as punched frames along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A perforated rail crossing an orange field.
options.case: Fuses poorly: editing metaphors don't map to explaining concepts.
options.kept: Commit the signal color at field scale.
options.risk: Heavy orange fatigues a reading surface.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground with one action color.
options.case: Fuses poorly: this is the generic look the redesign is replacing.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Symbol shape is direction, shading is level, length is exact duration.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an expert notation readers must learn first.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean AI-assistant explainer card, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Title, summary card, a grid of cards, a tip callout.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other assistant by design.
